instruction: The owner requested release of the Navrang app and website on 10 November 2026. This patch corrects the signed-out message control found during final verification.
deviceEvidence: The original-key-signed 0.9.4 APK upgraded published 0.9.3 in place on the dedicated Android API 37 emulator, retaining the app ID, app data directory and original install time. Both versions launched.
publicationInstruction: Publish Navrang 0.9.4 using the existing release channel and original signing identity.
